bc6656.title: Assessment target map
bc6656.content:
Authorized scope:

- Web application: `https://sahamlens.id` only.
- Local source: `/workspace/app` (mounted from `/opt/sahamlens/app`).

User constraints:

- Low-risk, non-destructive production testing only.
- No credential brute force/password guessing.
- No DoS/load testing.
- No destructive payloads or data modification.
- Do not submit forms that create/update/delete real records.
- Prefer passive/low-rate checks: headers, TLS, cookies, exposed routes, public API behavior, auth-boundary observations, common misconfiguration, non-persistent reflected XSS probes, IDOR review without changing data.
- Use source code to prioritize and reduce live probing.
